D0.name: empiricalMean
D0.declaration:
noncomputable def empiricalMean (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, y t) / n

D1.name: meanPredict
D1.declaration:
noncomputable def meanPredict (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 1/2 else empiricalMean y t

D2.name: comparatorRegret
D2.declaration:
noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (prediction t)) - ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t u

D3.name: squaredBestRegret
D3.declaration:
noncomputable def squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t - y t)^2) -
    sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

propositions.header:
theorem guessing_prefix_minimum (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    empiricalMean y T ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (empiricalMean y T - y t)^2) ≤
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2
propositions.neutral:
def Q001 : Prop := ∀ (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        D0 y T ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (D0 y T - y t)^2) ≤
          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2

propositions.header:
theorem squaredLoss_minimum_eq (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (empiricalMean y T - y t)^2
propositions.neutral:
def Q002 : Prop := ∀ (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (D0 y T - y t)^2

propositions.header:
theorem squaredBestRegret_eq_comparatorRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    squaredBestRegret y prediction T =
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) prediction (empiricalMean y T) T
propositions.neutral:
def Q003 : Prop := ∀ (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        D3 y prediction T =
      D2 (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) prediction (D0 y T) T

propositions.header:
theorem comparatorRegret_le_squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) prediction u T ≤
      squaredBestRegret y prediction T
propositions.neutral:
def Q004 : Prop := ∀ (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        D2 (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) prediction u T ≤
      D3 y prediction T

propositions.header:
theorem meanPredict_bestRegret_bound (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    squaredBestRegret y (meanPredict y) T ≤ 4 + 4 * Real.log T

theorem meanPredict_bestRegret_refined (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    squaredBestRegret y (meanPredict y) T ≤
      (1 : ℝ) / 4 + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (T - 1), 4 / ((t : ℝ) + 2)
propositions.neutral:
def Q006 : Prop := ∀ (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        D3 y (D1 y) T ≤
      (1 : ℝ) / 4 + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (T - 1), 4 / ((t : ℝ) + 2)
